_about: Routes that appear only on the regional sites (usa/, europe/, world/). Added 14 Nov 2026 to cover study tours and short programmes. Each was checked against search results that day; dates not yet published are said so. Verify on the official page before acting.

paths.name: Johns Hopkins Graduate Summer Institute of Epidemiology & Biostatistics
paths.cost: Self-funded: tuition per course or credit (2027 fees not yet published)
paths.time: Runs every June in Baltimore; courses from 4 hours to 2 weeks, in person, hybrid or online
paths.dt: 2027 dates not yet published (the 2025 institute ran 9–27 June). Registration usually opens in March.
paths.note: A short, paid study visit to the school behind the Hopkins PhD and MPH on this site. Open to non-degree participants, with a page for international participants. Online courses avoid a visa and the B1/B2 bond. A credit-bearing course gives a Hopkins transcript line and a contact in the department, but it is not a scholarship and does not count as US clinical experience. Fee figures found were from 2014, so they are not quoted here.

paths.name: Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting (Physiology/Medicine)
paths.cost: Selected young scientists attend free; travel support depends on the nominating body
paths.time: One week at Lake Constance with Nobel laureates and about 600 young scientists
paths.dt: 2027 meeting runs 27 Jun – 2 Jul 2027. National nomination rounds closed Sep–Oct 2026 (the last found, Malta, on 30 Oct).
paths.note: Entry is by nomination through an academic partner (national academies, universities, funders). Participants are students, PhD candidates and young postdocs in the meeting's field. Whether Bangladesh has a nominating partner has not been checked. The 2027 round is gone; the next medicine meeting is a later cycle (2028 is Physics). Worth asking a Bangladeshi academy or university early in a future Physiology/Medicine year.

paths.name: Sakura Science Exchange Program (JST, Japan)
paths.cost: JST pays travel and stay for selected programmes (airfare only when a private company hosts)
paths.time: Short invited visit to a Japanese university or institute; must end within Japan's fiscal year
paths.dt: No individual application: a Japanese host applies to JST. The FY2026 window was 16 Feb – 2 Apr 2026; the FY2027 call is expected around Feb 2027.
paths.note: A free short trip to Japan. Participants can be graduate students, postdocs, faculty or people working in science-related public institutions. You cannot apply yourself: the route is to get a Japanese lab (for example one you would want for MEXT or OIST) to include you in its JST application. Bangladesh eligibility was not shown on a current country list (older guidelines said generally all countries). Also a good way to meet a MEXT University Recommendation supervisor.
